description: Travel and mobility gear rental marketplace founded by Punsri Abeywickrema and headquartered in Coconut Creek, Florida, renting mobility scooters, wheelchairs, strollers, cribs, car seats and medical equipment through local partners, delivered to hotels, vacation rentals, homes, attractions, cruise ports and airports.

evidence.summary: Cloud of Goods' official affiliate page states verbatim: 'Earn commission on every completed order. No caps on how much you can earn.' Its FAQ sets a special 12% rate until September 2027 for anyone joining before December 31, 2026, resetting to a standard 10% rate after that, with real-time tracking and automated monthly payouts.

The same page opens the program to travel agents, hotel concierges, tour operators, content creators, bloggers and influencers, but names only three example partners (one travel influencer, one resort concierge, one travel agent); searches for sponsored creator content surfaced no paid-partnership posts, indicating a thin creator footprint next to its B2B channels.
The affiliate page footer publishes info@cloudofgoods.com and the company's Coconut Creek, FL address, and sign-up is a free affiliate account created 'in under 2 minutes' with no additional fees.

name: Cloud of Goods

reasons.compensation: 10% standard commission (12% promo rate into September 2027) on every completed rental order, explicitly stated as uncapped on the brand's own page, with recurring earnings as customers re-rent.
reasons.contact_access: A published contact email on the official program page plus a two-minute self-serve sign-up — near top band per the rubric.
reasons.credibility: Established rental marketplace with national PR coverage, a BBB profile and delivery operations across many US destination cities.
reasons.niche_fit: Gear rental is a genuine travel-creator niche (family travel, accessible travel, cruises, theme parks), though it is a service rather than a shoppable product.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up today for creators, bloggers and influencers with no fees and no stated follower minimum.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal affiliate program that explicitly courts travel influencers on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, but with only a handful of named example partners so far.

description: Door-to-door luggage and sports-equipment shipping service founded in 2004 and based in Boston, Massachusetts, that collects suitcases, golf clubs, skis and other travel items from a customer's doorstep and delivers them to their destination; it positions itself as an official luggage shipping partner for luxury cruise lines and tour operators.

evidence.summary: Luggage Forward's official affiliate page answers its 'How Much Can I Earn?' section with: 'As much as you want. Commissions start at 8% and our average booking is around $400', with commissions paid quarterly once earnings pass $25 — an earnings question answered with no limit stated.

The brand's published Affiliate Terms and Conditions confirm the mechanics behind the page: an 8% commission on money received from eligible transactions, remitted quarterly within 30 days of quarter end once the balance exceeds $25, by check in US dollars.

The program is built for travel agents rather than social creators — its own materials address agents throughout — and a search for creator promotion surfaced only a single promotional Instagram post by one travel creator (@pixelpathsw), indicating a very small creator footprint.

Sovrn Commerce's merchant profile describes Luggage Forward as founded in 2004 and based in Boston, Massachusetts, specializing in door-to-door luggage and sports-equipment shipping, and also lists the program for affiliate marketers on its network.

name: Luggage Forward

reasons.compensation: 8% commission on high-value bookings (average around $400 per the brand) with the earnings question answered 'As much as you want' — no cap stated — though payouts are quarterly rather than monthly.
reasons.contact_access: A public registration route from the official page, but no published partnerships email — mid-range per the rubric.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2004 with cruise-line and tour-operator partnerships and a long review history.
reasons.niche_fit: Luggage shipping is a natural fit for cruise, luxury and family travel creators, though it is a logistics service rather than a product haul niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Registration is open now from the affiliate page; the program also runs through Sovrn Commerce.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A real, long-running affiliate program with banners, links and an onsite booking app, but designed around travel agents, so the creator-specific layer is minimal.

description: Premium aviation headset maker whose affiliate program lets pilots and aviation creators earn commission promoting its premium headsets through a custom referral URL, with monthly payouts via PayPal.

The same page shows a deliberately small, professional program: applications are reviewed, affiliates must supply Tax ID documents, and the brand anticipates a minimum of one headset sale per month (12 per year) to stay in the program — a restricted pool of pilot-creators rather than an open influencer roster.

name: Lightspeed Aviation

reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured affiliate program with custom URLs and a dashboard, aimed at product-owning pilots who create content.

description: US suncare and skincare brand built on medical-grade formulations made in the USA at FDA-registered facilities, sold through its own website; its affiliate program also covers sister brand 7 Good Cows, a natural tallow-based skincare line, so affiliates can promote both brands under one program.

name: Bio2 SunCare

reasons.credibility: Small US brand with FDA-registered manufacturing claims but limited independent coverage so far.

reasons.ugc_evidence: A real affiliate program with multi-level pathways and ambassador/event roles for proven affiliates, run hands-on by the brand team.

description: Flint, Michigan all-natural skin, hair and body care brand founded in 2017 by La'Asia Johnson, selling handmade body butters, body oils, body washes, scrubs, candles and beard care online, on Etsy and from its own Flint boutique, where customers can mix custom products at an in-store mixology table.

The Flint Courier News publishes owner La'Asia Johnson's contact details for the business: phone 810-814-1443 and email info@ElleJaeEssentials.com.

The brand's own affiliate newsletter shows higher tiers above the standard rate — 20% commission on Essentials Club and Premium Line sales (versus standard 10%) and a 20% Bundle Builder rate with a $50 bonus for the first five sales — and names its affiliate manager (Jenny, jenny@beautybyearth.com) with weekly affiliate meetups.

The brand's own collaboration FAQ states: 'As a small business, we don't currently offer paid content campaigns, but would be happy to send gifted products in exchange for posts or videos. You can also sign up to be an affiliate with us and earn cash when you bring in sales!' No creator counts are published, so creator saturation is marked unknown rather than assumed.

The Female Founder Collective profile recounts founder Prudence Millsap launching Beauty by Earth in January 2014, bootstrapped with no outside funding, and growing from zero to 50,000 sales in its first year on Amazon.

description: The Tiffen Company of Hauppauge, New York — a manufacturer of photographic filters and imaging accessories founded by Sol Tiffen in 1938, whose filters are made in its Long Island factory and whose brand family includes Steadicam camera stabilizers, Domke camera bags, Lowel lighting and Davis & Sanford tripods, sold to photographers, filmmakers and content creators.

evidence.summary: Tiffen's official affiliate page states: 'Earn 10% on any sales made using your referral', 'FREE TO JOIN — Signing up is completely FREE and takes only a few minutes to register', and under UNLIMITED EARNINGS: 'Refer as many people as you'd like with no cap on the commision you can earn.'

Wikipedia's company profile places Tiffen in Hauppauge, New York, manufacturing filters for photography and professional film products, notes Academy Awards for technical achievements in filtration, and lists its owned brands: Steadicam, Domke, Lowel Light, Davis & Sanford, Listec, Stroboframe and Zing Designs.

Tiffen's own About page describes 85+ years supplying the consumer/professional photography, motion picture and broadcast industries; the affiliate offer is a simple open referral page with no ambassador community, creator roster or published creator counts, so creator saturation is marked unknown rather than assumed low.

The brand's own Instagram announcement (October 14, 2025) launches the Brand Ambassador Program as a brand-new program — 'Become a Brand Ambassador' with tier graphics — direct evidence the creator program only recently opened and is still building its first ambassador base.

The brand's Ambassador Toolkit support page confirms ambassadors start at 20% on qualifying first-time purchases and unlock tiers up to 35% plus monthly bonuses, and publishes the ambassador team contact route via the support portal.

No fetched source states an earnings cap or its absence, so commission_cap is marked unknown.

The same page shows a tiny, founder-led operation: the product reviews displayed on the program page number just 10, and the affiliate community is small enough that partners are invited to help choose names for new products.

The page tells founder Samantha Vickers' story — a master herbalist who spent decades studying herbs — and describes formulas as slow-crafted with whole herbs, nourishing oils, pure ingredients and raw beeswax, with a portion of every purchase supporting Safe Haven Baby Boxes.
